title: Map of key black sites in Greer's brief

tellings.quote: This is the brief. There is a map in there that actually has where all the key black sites are and where all this stuff is.

plain: Steven Greer heads a group that pushes for governments to reveal what they know about non-human visitors. On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, he held up what he calls "the brief", a document he says he helped put together. Greer says it holds a map showing where the key "black sites" are, meaning hidden secret facilities, and where "all this stuff" is kept. If that were true, it would point to the places where such secrets are stored.
